parties.petitioner: Shri. Masaidevi Vividh Karyakari Sahakari Seva Sanstha Maryadit Warewadi

summary: The appeal challenged the Bombay High Court's order dated 05.01.2024, which set aside the State of Maharashtra's decision to reject the registration of the appellant society as a Primary Agricultural Credit Co-operative Society (PACCS). The Scrutiny Committee had rejected the application on grounds including failure to verify jurisdictional overlap with an existing society, lack of verification of membership in other societies, absence of financial viability, non-submission of required documents (e.g., no-objection certificate, crop sowing register, 7/12 extracts), and non-compliance with the Government Resolution dated 23.09.2013. The High Court had allowed the petition, but the Supreme Court granted leave to appeal, indicating review of the legal issue concerning compliance with registration criteria and financial viability norms for co-operative societies.
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter pending further adjudication
